# Best noise-cancelling earbuds under $150

I can't browse, so the links below go to the review pages where each retailer buy button sits. Prices come from those pages and change often, so check the current price before you buy.

## Top picks

**Best for most people: Sony WF-C710N, about $119-$128**
- What Hi-Fi? names it best budget, with "fulsome, controlled bass." It's listed at $119 at Walmart and $128 at Best Buy and Sweetwater.
- Soundmavericks credits it with 8.5 hours of battery with ANC on, plus Sony's adaptive ANC and app. It has no LDAC.
- [Buy links (What Hi-Fi?)](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-the-true-wireless-way-to-cut-out-background-noise)

**Best for Android: Samsung Galaxy Buds3 Pro, about $134**
- SlashGear says you can get a new pair from Samsung's official Amazon store for $134. They have adaptive ANC, IPX7 and up to 18 hours of battery with the case.
- [Details and buy link (SlashGear)](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)

**Best for iPhone: AirPods Pro 2, just under $150 (renewed, on sale)**
- SlashGear calls their noise cancelling "in a class of its own." Apple no longer sells them new, so you'd be buying renewed or from third-party sellers, and sales vary.
- [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)
- If you'd rather buy new, the AirPods 5 with ANC are $129 ($149 with wireless charging). Their open fit blocks less noise than sealed earbuds. [iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/)

**Strongest ANC under $150, any phone: Nothing Ear (3), just under $150**
- SoundGuys scores their ANC 8.2/10, per iTech Level. They have LDAC, multipoint and wireless charging.
- Drawbacks are bass-heavy tuning, muffled call mics and about 5 hours per charge with ANC on.
- [iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/)

## Cheaper options

- **Soundcore P31i, $59.99:** It has adaptive ANC, multipoint, IP55 and about 8 hours per charge with ANC on. Amazon shows a 4.4-star average over 8,000+ reviews. The ANC won't match the pricier pairs. [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)
- **Anker Soundcore Space A40:** RTINGS' best budget pick. It has strong adaptive ANC and LDAC, but a poor mic for calls. The excerpt gave no price. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-earbuds)
- **Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro:** It lists at $149.99 and is often discounted to around $100. It has LDAC, wireless charging and IPX5. [iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/)

## Other notes

- **EarFun Air Pro 4:** Soundmavericks ranks it #1, but it compares specs and third-party measurements rather than testing hands-on, so I'd treat it as a promising option rather than a proven winner. [Soundmavericks](https://soundmavericks.com/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-under-150/)
- **Flagships:** The Bose QuietComfort Ultra Earbuds (2nd Gen) at $299 and the Sony WF-1000XM6 have the best ANC overall, but both are well over budget.

**Quick pick:** Android users should get the Galaxy Buds3 Pro, iPhone users a renewed AirPods Pro 2, and anyone else the Sony WF-C710N. If you want maximum noise blocking, go with the Nothing Ear (3). Tell me your phone and what matters most (battery, calls, gym use) and I can narrow it down.
